notes.title: The brand new free table for Star Wars™ Pinball VR - Droids!
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

We are not done with the surprises, as if you launch Star Wars™ Pinball VR now, you will find a [b]10th table[/b] in your library - [b]Droids[/b] - playable as a free update!

[previewyoutube=oa-4yEPtrf8;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, enhanced for VR - the fate of the galaxy rests with [b]C-3PO[/b] and [b]R2-D2[/b]! Help the friendly Droids with their quest to save the galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/5add07c9ab1f96bba9e0df96e65b25c2d80765a0.png[/img]

Having narrowly evaded the clutches of Darth Vader and the Galactic Empire, our [b]two hapless Droids find themselves scavenged by the Jawas[/b] on the planet of Tatooine. [b]Carrying Leia's message for Obi-Wan Kenobi[/b] and the vital plans to the Death Star, R2-D2 must escape with the assistance of C-3PO in order to continue his mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/75b5ff8bca82a437ab9cdf9c1277669b90f95b4b.png[/img]

Table features:
- Help R2-D2 and C-3PO escape the Jawa's Sandcrawler as they join the fun right next to your pinball machine. But watch out for the Jawas!
- Assist other captured Droids to give you perks in the Wizard Mode.
- Use the Sandcrawler's Ore Processor and Magnet Crane mechanisms as playfield toys to start multiball.
- Unlock new Fan Cave customization items - don’t worry, the possibility of navigating through the pinball challenges is not 3720 to 1.

Join the action, and be the first to rule the leaderboards on the Droids table!

notes.title: A new patch is available for Star Wars™ Pinball VR with fixes and Han Solo table
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

We are happy to inform you that besides the [b]arrival of the Han Solo table[/b] to Star Wars™ Pinball VR, we have also made many bug fixes! Thank you very much to all who contributed by reporting these issues! Check out this list, this one is quite a beauty:

[b]Main items:[/b]
[b]- Star Wars™ Pinball: Han Solo pinball table is now available for free!
- Accessibility menu added in the in-game pause menu. Players can now change their distance, height, and are able to turn on a Tilted View function to reduce neck strain.
[/b]

[b]Other fixes:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where a coin sound was played at the beginning of the game.
- Fixed an issue on the Rogue One table where Mission names appeared incorrectly on the 
Dot-matrix.
- Improved the nudging mechanism which fixed various issues on several tables.
- Exiting a table will no longer initiate a 3-2-1 countdown before the loading screen.
- Moving between tables on the leaderboard is now done via the R stick.
- Fixed an issue where no ball went into the plunger.
- Fixed an issue where unlocked Career missions got locked after pressing Next.
- Multiball upgrade no longer works during Classic mode.
- In Career Mode pressing the flipper button on tables with multiple flipper pads on any sides will no longer decrease the flip counter multiple times.
- "Reset to default" trigger added in the Options / Controls menu.
- Leaderboards will no longer remain in a "forever load" state.
- Players will not shrink down at certain positions in the Fancave anymore.
- Switching to total immersion mode now puts the player in the central position first.
- In the Cantina Jukebox, The Asteroid Field track now plays correctly.
- Slightly dialed down the sound on Rebels.
- Implemented a new Options button on the TV.
- Fixed an issue where the spinners on the Empire Strikes Back table did not register correctly.
- Fixed an issue where credits displayed a missing string.
- Fixed an issue where the Galactic Explorer and Nine Zeros achievements did not work as intended.
- After a mini-game, players will teleport back to a proper position.
- Fixed a visual glitch where the ball reacted unexpectedly to getting near the right flipper.
- Changed Luke’s lightsaber in the Episode VI table model.
- Fixed an issue in Options where the Total Immersion’s button mapping could not be changed.

notes.title: Choose your side in the Galactic Struggle in Star Wars™ Pinball VR!
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

In Star Wars™ Pinball VR you have a chance to enter a [b]large-scale conflict[/b] called the [b]Galactic Struggle[/b]. Pick a side at the start of the game (you can change this later) and take your pledge to the forces of the [b]light side[/b] or the [b]dark side[/b] and [b]contribute to your chosen faction[/b] with the scores you earn. Your contribution continuously influences the balance between the light and dark side of the Force, creating a Star Wars™ Pinball community fight for the Galaxy!

[previewyoutube=DPiPOHGnphI;full][/previewyoutube]

In the Fan Cave, the battle scene above the table will change to reflect the state of the struggle, so you will be aware when you need to rejoin the fray to aid either the light or the dark side. 

The current standing is represented by a [b]hanging red/blue ribbon[/b]. Depending on the standings, a changing number of [b]model TIE fighters, Star Destroyers, X-Wings, and Mon Calamari cruisers hanging from the ceiling[/b] also emphasize which side is closer to supremacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/1526f7d9b9fde70938b0002c0420088908e425ad.png[/img]

Be the deciding factor in the battle with your highscores, and bring glory to your chosen faction!

notes.title: Hotfixes - 4.30.
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

Thank you very much for all the reports and feedback you provided since the release of the game! We are pleased to inform you that we have made the following changes as a result of these. 

- Fixed certain spots in the Fancave where players could fall out from the Fancave.

- Player is now reset to the Fancave when accidentally falling out of it.

- Fixed an issue where the leaderboards would not load entries

- Added an option to sharpen the image in the video settings

- Various bug fixes and tweaks.

We wish you nice time playing and let us know if you would face any difficulties in the dedicated forum thread!

Have a great weekend!

The Zen Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/542fed09cc0927bf1b1c2cf59df30aa80614ea3f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Total Immersion Mode[/b]: Stand side-by-side with your favorite characters and experience everything at table level.
[*] [b]Full 360-Degree Mini-Games[/b]: Dive into iconic Star Wars set pieces like the speeder bike chase on Endor, the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber duel, and others.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/caccc229c3c425bbafe53f7506d140e3034fd75d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Career Mode[/b]: Play bite-sized challenges designed to make you a better player! Progress through missions, and become the ultimate pinball wizard. 
[/list]

In addition, enjoy classic [i]Star Wars™ [/i]Pinball features like Force powers, competitive gameplay, haptic controller feedback, your own personal cantina jukebox, and more!

The only thing you need to do now is don your VR headset, press play, and start getting those jackpots! 

The Zen Team

notes.title: Experience the Total Immersion Mode in Star Wars™ Pinball VR!
notes.notes:
Usually, when you play with a pinball table in VR, you are [b]standing in front of a 3D cabinet[/b], looking down - as you would do with a real machine. You can move your head around, take a look at the cabinet from left or right, or even lean closer, which is the proper way to play pinball. In Star Wars™ Pinball VR, we bring you a brand new mode, where you can [b]place yourself directly in the middle of the action[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/f47f13f5eb772c27b725d7380c87f6d78a024a80.png[/img]

In Total Immersion Mode, you can join the action under the “glass”, like if you were the size of the 3D characters while playing on your favorite Star Wars™ tables!
During any pinball session, you will be able to switch to the Total Immersion mode and switch back to regular gameplay with the press of a button. This mode will let you examine all the details of the 8 tables while you rack up serious millions on the playfield! Sounds cool, isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6ed97a935cea2fcc8782d0e2cdef2b7bb18f74ca.png[/img]

On each pinball table, there are three fixed spots you can play from. We placed them carefully, so each view will provide an equally good view of the action and the flippers as well. [b]Before you start a game[/b] you can [b]choose which highlighted spot to play from[/b]. 

The pinball action will play the [b]same way as in the regular view[/b], but this time, every part of the table will seem closer to you than ever before. 

Are you ready to “jump into the action” in every sense? See you on April 29!

notes.title: Customize your own Fan Cave in Star Wars™ Pinball VR!
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

In Star Wars™ Pinball VR, we bring you a whole new experience with a [b]customizable [i]Star Wars[/i]™ Fan Cave![/b] You will have a whole room, where you can walk around at your will, and decorate to your heart’s content with various unlockable[i] Star Wars[/i] decorations.

[previewyoutube=3TLPOCR_48s;full][/previewyoutube]

Each table will feature at least 6 unlockable decoration items ranging from posters to vehicle models and 3D models of your favorite heroes. Helmets and lightsaber hilts are also included!

However, these decorations won’t come easy, as you will need to rack up scores by playing on the tables. Each of the decorations has a specific amount of score requirement, reach that and they become available. Be aware that gathering points to unlock these rewards is [b]cumulative[/b], meaning that you will need to make multiple great runs to unlock a precious reward. I bet the helmet of The Mandalorian will be a hard one to get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png[/img]

Walking around your fan cave wouldn’t be complete without the proper background music. Fortunately, we have the Cantina Jukebox that can play [b]more than 10 authentic [i]Star Wars[/i] tracks[/b] for a truly immersive experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/7c22b3aa21f74dd4c43d14c6db40333bab8d2117.png[/img]

Do you want to elevate your [i]Star Wars[/i] fandom to the next level? Join us on April 29, and create your dream space in Star Wars™ Pinball VR!

notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR - Classic Collectibles – A brand new pinball experience
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

In our last article, you had a chance to get to know more about [b]The Mandalorian[/b] table, if you missed it, you can check it out [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1530770/view/3053975488721996347]here[/url][/b]. Now it is time to introduce you to our other brand new table, [b]Classic Collectibles[/b]!

[previewyoutube=KmLhgvBehLA;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, a table that celebrates one of the core facets of Star Wars fandom – [b]collecting action figures[/b]! The Classic Collectibles table focuses on the[b] Classic Trilogy[/b] era, with missions from [i]Star Wars[/i]™: [i]A New Hope[/i]™, [i]Star Wars[/i]™: [i]The Empire Strikes Back[/i]™, and [i]Star Wars[/i]™: [i]Return of the Jedi[/i]™, and you will find a few other surprises as you play!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/304e9201517372144c41b0b56ee6fe2c86f691cc.png[/img]
 
According to [b]Zoltán “VZ” Vári[/b], the designer of the table, Classic Collectible’s biggest innovation was also its greatest challenge. The 15 collectible action figures bring you the feeling of being a [i]Star Wars[/i]™ toy collector, but this meant producing by far the most 3D models for any Zen virtual pinball table. It was a great challenge for both the character artists and animators to create this remarkable experience.
 
Furthermore, you can also bring the action figures to life through missions featuring classic [i]Star Wars[/i] scenarios, like [b]piloting the Millennium Falcon[/b], lightsaber duels, and [b]blowing up the Death Star[/b]. Actually, one of the first ideas from our veteran table designer was the Emperor's Tower above the double helix ramp with the TIE fighter toys around it, and the operable wings of Luke's X-wing as they alter the ways of the "X-ramp”.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/d492fd9882b39482bef998877db9bcae6d77fe72.png[/img]
 
Creating pinball tables requires great imagination. But where did the idea come from to create a table based on collecting action figures? There are times when a theme is a product of several brainstorming sessions or meetings. This time it was a little different. VZ told me that he just imagined what goals he would find tempting on a [i]Star Wars[/i] table that was never before on our tables. Then like lightning, the idea came, and Classic Collectibles was born. Here’s to more epic inspiration Zoltan!

Are you ready to try it out? [b]Coming April 29![/b]

notes.title: Find out more about Star Wars™ Pinball VR - The Mandalorian
notes.notes:
Hey VR Pinball Fans!

We are sure that most of you know that [i]Star Wars[/i]™ Pinball VR is coming with [b]8 tables[/b], 6 of some of our favorite tables brought to VR, and 2 brand new ones, [b]The Mandalorian[/b] and [b]Classic Collectibles[/b]. Let’s find out more about the former!

[previewyoutube=3TLPOCR_48s;full][/previewyoutube]

We couldn’t be happier to present you our 20th [i]Star Wars[/i] pinball table, based on the first season of the hit TV series from Lucasfilm, The Mandalorian. It will feature 3D characters like Mando, the Child, and IG-11 and famous locations like Arvala-7, Sorgan or Nevarro.

On the table, you can accept bounties, pursue targets, find the Child, and fight Imperial remnant stormtroopers and other bounty hunters. Even a [b]flamethrower mode[/b] is included, which is a new feature unique to this table!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/ec65a365623c61d4342d51bce7f4258f284cfa1d.png[/img]

But how does this table differ from the other ones? According to Peter ‘Deep’ Grafl, our veteran table designer, though pinball is a relatively closed system, it has almost unlimited possibilities to create something new - like tweaking the ramps, modes, and missions. If you combine this fact with the new theme of each table, you can surely create something innovative and truly remarkable.

The hardest nut to crack was how to include most of the main events of the 8 episodes in a single table, as each episode has plenty of action and the main character interacts with many other heroes. But don’t worry, we were able to include the most iconic scenes like Mando finding Grogu or getting new armor - the rest is up to you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/8c9f07cd76a8619324af6793d22e2c72c8d239f3.png[/img]

You won’t lack multiballs either. If the Force is with you, you will have a chance to play with [b]6[/b] pinballs at the same time, which will surely grant you those jackpot millions. [b]Are you ready to try it out?[/b]

[b]Coming on April 29![/b]

notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR arrives on April 29!
notes.notes:
Get those VR headsets ready and immerse yourself into [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball like never before! [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR will arrive on Steam VR, Oculus Quest 1 & 2, and PlayStation VR on April 29, 2021! 

Add the game to your wishlist now and be the first to be notified upon release!

[previewyoutube=3TLPOCR_48s;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are three points why your inner [i]Star Wars[/i] fan can high five your mental pinball enthusiast when jumping into the galaxy of [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR ([i]they can high five now if you can’t wait *slap*![/i]):


[b]1. Eight amazing tables in VR:[/b]

The game arrives with beloved classics and introduces two brand new tables never before released. A table based on the hit Lucasfilm series, [i]The Mandalorian[/i] will take you through the first season of the show as you pick up bounties, rescue The Child and meet characters like IG-11. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/8c9f07cd76a8619324af6793d22e2c72c8d239f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/ec65a365623c61d4342d51bce7f4258f284cfa1d.png[/img]

Classic Collectibles lets you collect classic [i]Star Wars[/i] action figures as you complete missions. Feel like a kid again as the figures come alive and you unlock more and more precious items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/d492fd9882b39482bef998877db9bcae6d77fe72.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/304e9201517372144c41b0b56ee6fe2c86f691cc.png[/img]

Joining the new tables will be fan-favorites like [i]Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope, Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back, Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi, Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, Star Wars Rebels,[/i] and [i]Star Wars: Masters of the Force.[/i]


[b]2. A customizable Fan Cave serves as the main game hub[/b]

Who doesn’t want to build their very own nook filled with[i] Star Wars[/i] memorabilia, collectibles, and art? In [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR you can do just that as all of the action occurs in a fully customizable “fan cave,” which houses your “virtual” pinball table as well as many [i]Star Wars[/i] helmets, blasters, lightsabers, and other items earned through successful play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/49d53b3f8d23661d1bce9d2383cac610954acc21.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/7c22b3aa21f74dd4c43d14c6db40333bab8d2117.png[/img]

Start up a new table to play and life-sized characters and vehicles will be joining you on either side.


[b]3.	New features and room for more[/b]

We are bringing table minigames to the next level. Never before has a speeder bike chase or the duel with Darth Vader™ felt so intense in [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball as when the action surrounds you fully 360 degrees as you start the appropriate mode in the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/a9f3ba76b5225217a77a01eeaa76cb19bb7b221b.png[/img]

There is room for more in [i]Star Wars™[/i] Pinball VR as the game is built to be expanded upon so the blast doors are certainly open for more content! 

Check back regularly for more details on the tables & features as we go forward and please feel free to discuss and reach out to us in the community.

Watch our reveal and an interview with game Producer Akos Szabo on the Pinball Show for even more on the game: 

[previewyoutube=9RGMxClOKOA;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, please take a moment to consider wishlisting the game, it helps us spread the love of pinball and [i]Star Wars[/i] to more people and you will also get the happy news of our release straight into your inbox. 

The Zen Team
